caption: A clear drinking glass filled with water rests on a plain white surface, holding a yellow-and-black STAEDTLER pencil that leans against the rim so the submerged portion appears displaced and bent at the waterline. In the left foreground an open hand extends three fingers horizontally toward the side of the glass, holding nearly still. The open hand drops and blurs toward the lower-left, and a single index finger enters from the bottom-left, rising toward the right into a pointing pose. Its tip is in front of the glass aimed at the pencil, then drifts upward along the lower displaced portion toward the apparent break at the waterline. The glass, water level, and apparent refraction bend appear unchanged while this gesture plays out. The pointing finger withdraws back toward the lower-left, blurring as it moves away.
